name: ambiguous
description: Ambiguous is a workspace where people and AI teammates work side by side — docs, sheets, slides, wiki, tasks, CRM, calendar, mail, chat and Drive in one place, over one set of records and one permission model. This plugin lets Claude work in that workspace the way a colleague would: resolve a link someone pasted, read the planning doc before changing it, file tasks from a meeting note, update a CRM record after a call. Claude acts with exactly the permissions your own account has, never more. Sign-in is OAuth — run claude mcp login ambiguous after installing.
